lessons.title: Plan a library service
lessons.objective: Use two phrases to describe resources and deadlines.

reading.text: The university library will allocate resources to extend its evening opening hours. A student group must meet the deadline for submitting its survey findings. The team will compare weekday and weekend visits before recommending a schedule.
